title: 20-Minute Garlic Butter Pea Pasta
description: Hot pasta tossed with garlic butter, peas, and Parmesan for a genuinely fast pantry dinner.

steps.text: Boil pasta until tender; add peas for the last 2 minutes and drain.
Return to pot with butter, garlic, Parmesan, and pepper; toss until glossy.

cookSteps.text:
BOIL:
{{q0}} pasta

Cook until nearly tender.

ADD:
{{q3}} frozen peas

Boil with pasta until hot; drain.

TOSS IN HOT POT:
{{q1}} butter
{{q2}} garlic
{{q4}} Parmesan
{{q5}} black pepper

Stir with pasta and peas until glossy.

title: 20-Minute Pantry Egg Fried Rice
description: Cold cooked rice, eggs, peas, and soy sauce turned into dinner in one skillet.

steps.text: Scramble eggs in oil and move to a plate.
Heat vegetables and rice in the skillet, stir in soy sauce, then fold eggs back in.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT:
{{q4}} oil

SCRAMBLE:
{{q1}} eggs

Move eggs to a plate.

STIR-FRY:
{{q2}} frozen peas and carrots
{{q0}} cold cooked rice

Cook until hot.

STIR IN:
{{q3}} soy sauce

Fold scrambled eggs back in and heat through.

title: 20-Minute Black Bean Taco Rice Bowls
description: Warm rice and seasoned black beans topped with cheese and salsa for an easy meatless taco night.

ingredients.item: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat beans with taco seasoning and warm the rice.
Divide rice and beans into bowls and top with cheddar and salsa.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT IN SAUCEPAN:
{{q1}} black beans
{{q2}} taco seasoning

Stir until hot.

WARM:
{{q0}} cooked rice

BUILD BOWLS:
{{q0}} rice
{{q1}} seasoned beans
{{q3}} cheddar
{{q4}} salsa

storage: Refrigerate rice and beans up to 3 days.

title: 20-Minute Cheesy Beef Macaroni Skillet
description: Ground beef, quick-cooking macaroni, tomato sauce, and cheddar in a familiar weeknight skillet.

steps.text: Boil macaroni while browning the meat; drain both as needed.
Stir macaroni, tomato sauce, garlic powder, and cheddar into the skillet until hot and creamy.

cookSteps.text:
BOIL:
{{q0}} macaroni

At the same time, brown {{q1}} ground beef or turkey in a large skillet. Drain as needed.

STIR INTO SKILLET:
{{q0}} drained macaroni
{{q2}} tomato sauce
{{q4}} garlic powder

Heat through.

STIR IN:
{{q3}} shredded cheddar

Cook just until melted.

title: 20-Minute Sausage & Spinach Pasta
description: Fully cooked sausage, pasta, spinach, and marinara for a fast grocery-store dinner.

steps.text: Boil pasta while browning sliced sausage.
Add marinara and spinach to sausage, then toss with drained pasta.

cookSteps.text:
BOIL:
{{q0}} pasta

Meanwhile heat {{q4}} oil and brown {{q1}} sliced sausage in a skillet.

ADD TO SAUSAGE:
{{q3}} marinara
{{q2}} spinach

Stir until spinach wilts and sauce is hot.
TOSS IN drained pasta and serve hot.

title: 20-Minute Chickpea Stir-Fry Noodles
description: Quick noodles, frozen stir-fry vegetables, and chickpeas tossed in a simple soy sauce glaze.

steps.text: Boil noodles while stir-frying vegetables and chickpeas.
Drain noodles, add to skillet with soy sauce, and toss until hot.

cookSteps.text:
BOIL:
{{q0}} noodles

Cook until tender; drain.

STIR-FRY IN:
{{q4}} oil
{{q1}} frozen vegetables
{{q2}} chickpeas

Cook until vegetables are hot and crisp-tender.

ADD:
{{q0}} drained noodles
{{q3}} soy sauce

Toss until evenly coated and hot.

title: 20-Minute Chicken, Corn & Rice Skillet
description: Pre-cooked chicken, rice, corn, and cheddar warmed together for a practical no-fuss skillet dinner.

steps.text: Heat rice, chicken, corn, and broth together until steaming.
Top with cheddar, cover briefly, and let it melt.

cookSteps.text:
ADD TO SKILLET:
{{q0}} cooked rice
{{q1}} cooked chicken
{{q2}} frozen corn
{{q3}} chicken broth

Cover and heat, stirring once or twice.

TOP WITH:
{{q4}} shredded cheddar

Cover until melted.

title: 20-Minute Skillet Bean Enchiladas
description: Tortilla strips, black beans, enchilada sauce, and cheese simmered into an easy skillet version of enchiladas.

ingredients.item: corn or flour tortillas, cut into strips
canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Simmer tortilla strips, beans, corn, and enchilada sauce until hot and slightly thickened.
Top with cheese, cover, and melt.

cookSteps.text:
ADD TO SKILLET:
{{q0}} tortilla strips
{{q1}} black beans
{{q4}} frozen corn
{{q2}} enchilada sauce

Stir and simmer until hot.

TOP WITH:
{{q3}} shredded cheese

Cover until melted.
